Eric Bradley

title: Illinois Department of Innovation and Technology: Guidance and Policies Regarding llms.txt

communications.subject: Illinois Freedom of Information Act. Request: Illinois Department of Innovation and Technology: Guidance and Policies Regarding llms.txt
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting access to public records concerning statewide guidance, policies, or technical recommendations regarding `llms.txt` web files.

Specifically, please provide copies of the following records created or maintained from January 1, 2025, to the present:

1. All statewide IT policies, guidelines, circulars, technical bulletins, or advisories mentioning `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, or machine-readable documentation files intended for artificial intelligence indexing.
2. Any correspondence, inter-agency guidance, or technical briefings provided by DoIT to executive branch agencies or constitutional offices concerning the use or implementation of `llms.txt` web standards.

As this request is for non-commercial public research, I request a waiver of any reproduction fees. Please transmit the records electronically via email within the statutory timeframe.

Thank you for your assistance.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robert Delaware

title: Illinois State Treasurer: Public Records Request - Implementation of https://illinoistreasurer.gov/llms.txt

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting access to public records concerning the creation, implementation, and deployment of the llms.txt file located at https://illinoistreasurer.gov/llms.txt.

Specifically, please provide copies of the following records from January 1, 2025, to the present:

1. All internal guidelines, instructions, policies, or technical standards regarding the creation, formatting, approval, or maintenance of `llms.txt` or `llms-full.txt` pages.

2. All emails, electronic communications, support tickets, or project documentation involving Office of the Illinois State Treasurer IT/web staff and any external web development vendors, CMS platform providers, or SEO consultants regarding the deployment of `illinoistreasurer.gov/llms.txt`.

As this request is for non-commercial, public-interest research into how government agencies utilize machine-readable files for artificial intelligence systems, I request a waiver of any copying fees. Please provide the records in electronic format (via email) to expedite fulfillment within the statutory 5-business-day response window.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robert Delaware
